    (package private) static double
    MinimumRiskMovement.gunLineRisk(Point2D.Double p, List<Roster.Mate> mates, long now)
    TMODE-19: for each teammate whose stated aim is fresh and whose gun fires within MinimumRiskMovement.GUNLINE_TICKS ticks, MinimumRiskMovement.GUNLINE_K where p lies on the line from the teammate's place now along its gun heading, falling linearly to none MinimumRiskMovement.GUNLINE_HALF px off it; only between MinimumRiskMovement.GUNLINE_NEAR and MinimumRiskMovement.GUNLINE_REACH px ahead.
    (package private) static double
    MinimumRiskMovement.linesRisk(Point2D.Double p, List<Roster.Mate> mates, List<EnemyInfo> enemies, long now)
    TMODE-15: for each teammate, now, and its nearest fresh enemy, MinimumRiskMovement.LINES_K where p lies on the line from the teammate through that enemy and past it, falling linearly to none MinimumRiskMovement.LINES_HALF radians off the line as the teammate sees it, and none nearer the teammate than the enemy or more than MinimumRiskMovement.LINES_REACH px beyond it.
